value.rationale: The exact coefficient threshold separates a compact flow with no nonstationary periodic trajectory from one with two whole periodic annuli; this is a global orbit-topology statement. Geometric surface area of the periodic region vanishes at birth yet its integrated physical-time period has a nonzero sharp limit, and the latitude of this surviving weighted mass has a universal total-variation arcsine limit. This natural metric invariant extends the qualitative integrability classification and is not only a local saddle-node exercise.
